editorial.blurb: Beatrix Loop is a sunlit, plant-filled sanctuary serving thoughtfully executed American comfort food and exceptional coffee in a cozy-yet-polished setting.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead or arrive early on weeknights—the place fills up quickly, though reservations are accepted. The happy hour scene at the bar is lively on Friday afternoons.

topDishes.note: Perfectly balanced with creamy avocado, just-right eggs, fresh greens, and hearty bread that holds up
Very flavorful with great portion, served with asparagus
